R119.note: htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES,'UTF-8') on both concatenation points cleanly closes the reflected XSS with no other behavior change.

R120.note: Allowlist-mapped orderByRaw value is the correct approach since ORDER BY can't be parameterized; account_id constraint and day-window logic untouched.
